Article 33 When traffic police officers examine a road traffic accident scene, they shall, in accordance with relevant laws, regulations, and standards, take photographs of the scene, draw scene diagrams, promptly extract and collect traces, physical evidence, etc. related to the case, and prepare scene examination records. If during the scene examination process it is discovered that a party is suspected of using a means of transportation to commit other crimes, the crime scene and evidence shall be properly protected, the criminal suspect shall be controlled, and the competent department of the public security organ shall be reported immediately.

Provisions on Procedures for Handling Road Traffic Accidents
Chapter 6 Investigation and Examination > Section 2 On-site Disposal and Investigation > Article 38

Article 38 Where necessary for investigation, the traffic management department of the public security organ may organize parties to road traffic accidents and witnesses to identify criminal suspects, suspect vehicles, etc.

Identification shall be conducted under the direction of traffic police. The traffic police directing the identification shall not be fewer than two. When multiple identifiers identify the same object of identification, they shall do so individually.

During identification, the object of identification shall be mixed with other objects of similar characteristics, and no hints shall be given to the identifier. When identifying a criminal suspect, the number of people to be identified shall not be fewer than seven; when identifying a photograph of the criminal suspect, there shall be no fewer than ten photographs. When identifying a suspect vehicle, there shall be no fewer than five vehicles of the same type; when identifying a photograph of the suspect vehicle, there shall be no fewer than ten photographs.

For identification of specific objects such as corpses, or where the identifier can accurately describe unique characteristics of the criminal suspect or suspect vehicle, the numerical restrictions do not apply.

Where the identifier is unwilling to conduct the identification of a criminal suspect publicly, it may be conducted without exposing the identifier, and their identity shall be kept confidential.

A record of the identification process and results shall be made, signed by the traffic police, the identifier, and the witness. Where necessary, the identification process shall be recorded by audio or video.

Chapter 7 Determination and Review > Section 1 Determination of Road Traffic Accidents > Article 60

Article 60: The public security organ traffic management department shall determine the responsibility of the parties based on the role played by the conduct of the parties in the occurrence of the road traffic accident and the severity of their fault.

(1) Where a road traffic accident is caused by the fault of one party, that party shall bear full responsibility;
(2) Where a road traffic accident occurs due to the fault of two or more parties, they shall respectively bear primary responsibility, equal responsibility, or secondary responsibility based on the role of their conduct in the occurrence of the accident and the severity of their fault;
(3) Where none of the parties has fault leading to the road traffic accident and it belongs to a traffic accident, none of the parties shall bear responsibility.

If one party intentionally causes a road traffic accident, the other party shall bear no responsibility.

Article 61: A party shall bear full responsibility under any of the following circumstances:

(1) Fleeing the scene after a road traffic accident occurs;
(2) Intentionally destroying, fabricating the scene, or destroying evidence.

If a party abandons the vehicle and flees or hides to evade legal liability, and there is evidence proving that other parties are also at fault, responsibility may be appropriately mitigated; however, if there is simultaneously evidence proving that the fleeing party falls under the circumstances of Paragraph 1, Item 2 of this Article, responsibility shall not be mitigated.

Article 3: When handling motor vehicle driver's license business, vehicle management offices shall follow the principles of legality, openness, fairness, and convenience for the public.
Vehicle management offices handling motor vehicle driver's license business shall accept applications from applicants in accordance with the law and review the materials submitted by the applicants. For those who meet the conditions, motor vehicle driver's licenses shall be handled according to the prescribed standards, procedures, and time limits. For those who do not meet the conditions, the vehicle management office shall inform the reasons in writing or electronically.
Vehicle management offices shall publicize in their office premises the matters, conditions, basis, procedures, and time limits for handling motor vehicle driver's licenses as stipulated by laws, administrative regulations, and these provisions, as well as fee standards, the catalog of all materials to be submitted, and model texts of application forms.

Chapter 2: Application for Motor Vehicle Driver's License > Section 2: Application > Article 21

Article 21: Holders of foreign motor vehicle driver's licenses who need to temporarily drive motor vehicles shall apply to the vehicle management office for a temporary motor vehicle driving permit in accordance with regulations.

For those entering the country for a short stay, a temporary motor vehicle driving permit with a validity period of three months may be applied for; for those whose stay or residence period exceeds three months, the validity period may be extended to one year.

If a temporarily entering motor vehicle driver accumulates 12 points within one scoring cycle on their temporary motor vehicle driving permit and does not participate in the study and examination of road traffic safety laws, regulations, and related knowledge as prescribed, they shall not apply for a motor vehicle driver's license or apply again for a temporary motor vehicle driving permit.

Article 25: Persons holding foreign motor vehicle driver's licenses who apply for a motor vehicle driver's license shall confirm the application information and submit the following certificates and vouchers:

Article 28 Where the proofs and vouchers submitted by the applicant are complete and conform to the statutory form, the vehicle administration office shall accept them and examine the applicant's conditions for applying for a motor vehicle driver's license in accordance with the provisions. Where the public security organ traffic management department has already realized online verification with medical institutions and other units, the applicant is exempt from submitting proofs and vouchers such as physical condition certificates.
For those who meet the application conditions, the vehicle administration office shall arrange the examination appointment in accordance with the provisions; where no examination is required, the motor vehicle driver's license shall be issued within one day. Where an applicant who is a demobilized, transferred, or retired military personnel applies for a motor vehicle driver's license using a motor vehicle driver's license issued by the military or the Chinese People's Armed Police Force, the military or Chinese People's Armed Police Force motor vehicle driver's license shall be recovered.

Chapter 3 Examination of Motor Vehicle Drivers > Section 1 Examination Content and Passing Standards > Article 30

Article 30 The examination content for motor vehicle drivers is divided into the examination subject on road traffic safety laws, regulations, and related knowledge (hereinafter referred to as "Subject 1"), the examination subject on field driving skills (hereinafter referred to as "Subject 2"), and the examination subject on road driving skills and safe and civilized driving knowledge (hereinafter referred to as "Subject 3").
A person who already holds a driver's license for the authorized vehicle type of small automatic transmission automobiles and applies to add the authorized vehicle type of small automobiles shall be examined on Subject 2 and Subject 3.
A person who already holds a driver's license for the authorized vehicle types of large buses, urban public buses, medium-sized buses, large trucks, small automobiles, or small automatic transmission automobiles and applies to add the authorized vehicle type of light tractor-trailers shall be examined on Subject 2 and the safe and civilized driving knowledge of Subject 3.
A person who already holds a driver's license for the authorized vehicle type of light motorcycles and applies to add the authorized vehicle types of ordinary three-wheeled motorcycles or ordinary two-wheeled motorcycles, or a person who holds a driver's license for ordinary two-wheeled motorcycles and applies to add the authorized vehicle type of ordinary three-wheeled motorcycles, shall be examined on Subject 2 and Subject 3.
Where the physical condition of a motor vehicle driver who already holds a driver's license for the authorized vehicle types of large buses, heavy tractor-trailers, urban public buses, medium-sized buses, large trucks, small automobiles, or small automatic transmission automobiles changes, such that they no longer meet the conditions for the authorized vehicle type of the motor vehicle driver's license they hold, but meet the conditions for the authorized vehicle type of small automatic transmission passenger cars specially designed for persons with disabilities, and they apply for a change, they shall be examined on Subject 2 and Subject 3.

Chapter 3 Examination of Motor Vehicle Drivers > Section 1 Examination Content and Passing Standards > Article 34

Article 34: The examination content of Subject 3 Road Driving Skills Test includes: getting on the vehicle and preparation, starting, straight-line driving, gear shifting operation, changing lanes, pulling over to the side of the road, passing straight through an intersection, left turn at an intersection, right turn at an intersection, passing through a crosswalk, passing through a school area, passing through a bus stop, meeting oncoming vehicles, overtaking, making a U-turn, and night driving for large passenger buses, heavy tractor-trailers, urban buses, medium-sized passenger buses, large trucks, small cars, small automatic transmission cars, low-speed cargo vehicles, and small automatic transmission passenger cars specially designed for persons with disabilities. The examination content for other permitted vehicle types shall be determined by the traffic management department of the public security organ at the provincial level.
The test mileage for large passenger buses, heavy tractor-trailers, urban buses, medium-sized passenger buses, and large trucks shall not be less than 10 kilometers. Among them, for those applying for urban bus and large truck permitted vehicle types for the first time, the daytime test mileage shall not be less than 5 kilometers, and the nighttime test mileage shall not be less than 3 kilometers. The test mileage for small cars, small automatic transmission cars, low-speed cargo vehicles, and small automatic transmission passenger cars specially designed for persons with disabilities shall not be less than 3 kilometers. If the night test is not conducted, a simulated night lighting test shall be conducted.
For permitted vehicle types of large passenger buses, heavy tractor-trailers, urban buses, medium-sized passenger buses, and large trucks, the traffic management department of the public security organ at the provincial level shall add complex road driving test content such as mountainous areas, tunnels, and steep slopes according to actual circumstances. For other automobile permitted vehicle types, the traffic management department of the public security organ at the provincial level may add test content according to actual circumstances.

Article 39: The vehicle management office shall arrange examinations according to the appointed examination venue and time. After an applicant passes the Subject 1 examination, they may make an appointment for the Subject 2 or Subject 3 Road Driving Skills Test. In places with conditions, an applicant may simultaneously make appointments for Subject 2 and Subject 3 Road Driving Skills Tests, and after a successful appointment, the tests may be conducted consecutively. After both the Subject 2 and Subject 3 Road Driving Skills Tests are passed, the applicant may take the Subject 3 Safe and Civilized Driving Knowledge Test on the same day.
An applicant applying for a driver's license for large passenger buses, heavy tractor-trailers, urban buses, medium-sized passenger buses, large trucks, or light tractor-trailers may choose another examination venue within the province (autonomous region) to take the test if a Subject 2 examination venue has not yet been established locally.
During the period of applying for a driver's license for small cars, small automatic transmission cars, low-speed cargo vehicles, three-wheeled automobiles, small automatic transmission passenger cars specially designed for persons with disabilities, or light tractor-trailers, if the applicant's place of residence changes after passing some subject examinations, they may apply to change the examination location and make an appointment for other subject examinations at their current place of residence. An application to change the examination location shall not exceed three times.
The vehicle management office shall use the national unified examination appointment system and provide appointment services for applicants via the Internet, telephone, service windows, and other methods.

Article 65: Persons aged 63 years or older shall not drive large buses, heavy tractors, urban public buses, medium-sized buses, large trucks, wheeled special-purpose machinery vehicles, trolleybuses, or trams. Holders of driver's licenses for large buses, heavy tractors, urban public buses, medium-sized buses, or large trucks shall go to the vehicle management office where the motor vehicle driver's license was issued or at a vehicle management office outside the place of issuance to exchange for a motor vehicle driver's license with the authorized vehicle type of small cars or small automatic transmission cars; among them, those holding driver's licenses for heavy tractors may also retain the authorized vehicle type of light tractors. Article 72: Motor vehicle drivers shall, in accordance with the provisions of laws and administrative regulations, periodically undergo review and verification by the public security organ traffic management department.

Motor vehicle drivers aged 70 or above shall also undergo ability tests for memory, judgment, reaction, etc., in accordance with regulations during review and verification.
Those with road traffic safety violations or traffic accidents not yet handled, physical conditions not meeting the conditions for driving permission, or failure to participate in learning, education, and examinations as prescribed shall not pass the review and verification.

Chapter 6 Legal Liability > Article 93

Article 93 Where an applicant conceals relevant circumstances or provides false materials to apply for a motor vehicle driver's license, the public security organ traffic management department shall not accept or shall not handle the application, and shall impose a fine of not more than 500 yuan; the applicant shall not apply for a motor vehicle driver's license again within one year.
Where an applicant engages in bribery or cheating during the examination process, the examination qualification shall be cancelled, the results of other subjects already passed shall be invalid, and the public security organ traffic management department shall impose a fine of not more than 2,000 yuan; the applicant shall not apply for a motor vehicle driver's license again within one year.
Where an applicant obtains a motor vehicle driver's license by deception, bribery, or other improper means, the public security organ traffic management department shall confiscate the motor vehicle driver's license, revoke the motor vehicle driving permission, and impose a fine of not more than 2,000 yuan; the applicant shall not apply for a motor vehicle driver's license again within three years.
Where any of the acts in the preceding three paragraphs is organized or participated in for the purpose of obtaining economic benefits, the public security organ traffic management department shall impose a fine of not less than three times but not more than five times the illegal income, but the maximum shall not exceed 100,000 yuan.
Where an applicant conceals relevant circumstances or provides false materials to apply for school bus driving qualifications, the public security organ traffic management department shall not accept or shall not handle the application, and shall impose a fine of not more than 500 yuan; the applicant shall not apply for school bus driving qualifications again within one year. Where an applicant obtains school bus driving qualifications by deception, bribery, or other improper means, the public security organ traffic management department shall revoke the school bus driving qualifications and impose a fine of not more than 2,000 yuan; the applicant shall not apply for school bus driving qualifications again within three years.

Article 9 Where a registered motor vehicle reaches the mandatory scrapping standard prescribed by the state, the traffic management department of the public security organ shall notify the motor vehicle owner to handle cancellation registration 2 months before the expiration of the scrapping period. The motor vehicle owner shall sell the motor vehicle to a motor vehicle recycling enterprise before the expiration of the scrapping period, and the motor vehicle recycling enterprise shall submit the registration certificate, license plate, and driving license of the scrapped motor vehicle to the traffic management department of the public security organ for cancellation. Where the motor vehicle owner fails to handle cancellation registration within the time limit, the traffic management department of the public security organ shall announce that the registration certificate, license plate, and driving license of the motor vehicle are invalid.
Where applying for cancellation registration due to the loss of a motor vehicle, the motor vehicle owner shall submit his or her identity certificate to the traffic management department of the public security organ and return the motor vehicle registration certificate.

Chapter 3: Road Traffic Conditions > Article 35

Article 35: Road maintenance and construction units carrying out maintenance or repair work on roads shall set up standardized safety warning signs and safety protection facilities in accordance with regulations. Road maintenance and construction operation vehicles and machinery shall be equipped with warning lights and painted with obvious marking patterns, and warning lights and hazard warning flashers shall be turned on during operations. For construction operation roads where traffic has not been interrupted, the traffic management department of the public security organ shall strengthen traffic safety supervision and inspection. When traffic congestion occurs, timely diversion and guidance shall be carried out to maintain traffic order.

If road construction requires vehicles to detour, the construction unit shall set up signs at the detour location; if detour is not possible, a temporary passage shall be constructed to ensure the passage of vehicles and pedestrians. If it is necessary to close the road and interrupt traffic, except in emergency situations, an announcement shall be made to the society 5 days in advance.

Article 81 Motor vehicles traveling on expressways shall comply with the following provisions when encountering low-visibility meteorological conditions such as fog, rain, snow, sandstorms, or hail:

Chapter 5 Handling of Traffic Accidents > Article 76

Article 76 Where a motor vehicle causes personal injury or death or property loss in a traffic accident, the insurance company shall compensate within the liability limit of compulsory third-party liability insurance for motor vehicles; the insufficient part shall be borne for compensation liability in accordance with the following provisions:
(1) Where a traffic accident occurs between motor vehicles, the party at fault shall bear compensation liability; where both parties are at fault, they shall share responsibility in proportion to their respective faults.
(2) Where a traffic accident occurs between a motor vehicle and the driver of a non-motor vehicle or a pedestrian, if the driver of the non-motor vehicle or the pedestrian is not at fault, the motor vehicle side shall bear compensation liability; if there is evidence proving that the driver of the non-motor vehicle or the pedestrian is at fault, the compensation liability of the motor vehicle side shall be appropriately reduced according to the degree of fault; if the motor vehicle side is not at fault, it shall bear compensation liability not exceeding ten percent.
Where the loss of the traffic accident is caused by the driver of a non-motor vehicle or a pedestrian intentionally colliding with a motor vehicle, the motor vehicle side shall not bear compensation liability.

For the acts in the preceding two paragraphs, the motor vehicle shall be detained by the traffic management department of the public security organ until the illegal state is eliminated.
If the vehicles of a transport unit have the circumstances prescribed in the first and second paragraphs of this Article and fail to correct after punishment, the directly responsible person in charge shall be fined not less than two thousand yuan but not more than five thousand yuan.

Chapter 8 Supplementary Provisions > Article 119

Article 119: The following terms used in this Law have the following meanings:

(1) "Road" refers to highways, urban roads, and places that are under the jurisdiction of a unit but allow social motor vehicles to pass, including squares, public parking lots, and other places used for public passage.

(2) "Vehicle" refers to motor vehicles and non-motor vehicles.

(3) "Motor vehicle" refers to wheeled vehicles driven or towed by power devices, traveling on roads, used for carrying passengers or goods, or for engineering special operations.

(4) "Non-motor vehicle" refers to traffic tools driven by human or animal power, traveling on roads, as well as traffic tools such as motorized wheelchairs for the disabled and electric bicycles that, although driven by power devices, have design maximum speed, empty vehicle weight, and external dimensions conforming to relevant national standards.

(5) "Traffic accident" refers to incidents causing personal injury or death or property loss due to fault or accident involving vehicles on roads.

(1) "Road" refers to highways, urban roads, and places that are under the jurisdiction of a unit but allow social motor vehicles to pass, including squares, public parking lots, and other places used for public passage.

(2) "Vehicle" refers to motor vehicles and non-motor vehicles.

(3) "Motor vehicle" refers to wheeled vehicles driven or towed by power devices, traveling on roads, used for carrying passengers or goods, or for engineering special operations.

(4) "Non-motor vehicle" refers to traffic tools driven by human or animal power, traveling on roads, as well as traffic tools such as motorized wheelchairs for the disabled and electric bicycles that, although driven by power devices, have design maximum speed, empty vehicle weight, and external dimensions conforming to relevant national standards.

(5) "Traffic accident" refers to incidents causing personal injury or death or property loss due to fault or accident involving vehicles on roads.

Article 3 Vehicle management offices handling motor vehicle registration business shall follow the principles of lawfulness, openness, fairness, and convenience for the public.

Vehicle management offices handling motor vehicle registration business shall accept applications from applicants in accordance with the law, examine the materials submitted by applicants, and inspect motor vehicles in accordance with regulations. Article 18: Where the domicile of the owner of a motor vehicle moves out of the jurisdiction of the vehicle management office, the vehicle management office at the place of transfer-out shall, within three days from the date of acceptance, inspect the motor vehicle, endorse the change matters on the motor vehicle registration certificate, and prepare and upload the electronic archive data of the motor vehicle. The owner of the motor vehicle shall apply for transfer-in of the motor vehicle to the vehicle management office at the place of domicile within thirty days. Where the domicile of the owner of a small or micro passenger car or motorcycle moves out of the jurisdiction of the vehicle management office, an application for change registration shall be submitted to the vehicle management office at the place of transfer-in.

Upon application for transfer-in of a motor vehicle, the owner of the motor vehicle shall confirm the application information, submit identity proofs, the motor vehicle registration certificate, and present the motor vehicle for inspection. If the motor vehicle has exceeded the validity period of inspection at the time of transfer-in, a safety technical inspection shall be conducted in accordance with the provisions, and the motor vehicle safety technical inspection qualification certificate and the compulsory traffic accident liability insurance voucher shall be submitted. The vehicle management office shall, within three days from the date of acceptance, inspect the motor vehicle, collect and verify the vehicle identification number rubbing film or electronic data, examine the relevant proofs and vouchers and the electronic archive data of the motor vehicle, endorse the transfer-in information on the motor vehicle registration certificate, recover the license plates and driving license, determine a new motor vehicle license plate number, and issue license plates, driving license, and inspection qualification marks.

Before applying for transfer-out or transfer-in of a motor vehicle, the owner of the motor vehicle shall complete the handling of road traffic safety violations and traffic accidents involving the vehicle.

Article 20: Where the license plate numbers of motor vehicles under the name of the same owner need to be interchanged, and one of the following circumstances exists, an application for change registration may be submitted to the vehicle management office at the place of registration:
(1) The two motor vehicles are registered at vehicle management offices within the same jurisdiction;
(2) The two motor vehicles belong to the same type of license plate;
(3) The nature of use of the two motor vehicles is non-operating.

The owner of the motor vehicle shall confirm the application information, submit the identity proof of the owner of the motor vehicle, the registration certificates, driving licenses, and license plates of the two motor vehicles. Before application, the road traffic safety violations and traffic accidents of both vehicles shall be handled.

The vehicle management office shall, within one day from the date of acceptance, examine the submitted proofs and vouchers, endorse the change matters on the motor vehicle registration certificate, recover the license plates and driving licenses of both vehicles, and reissue license plates, driving licenses, and inspection qualification marks.

The license plate numbers of the same motor vehicle may be interchanged once within one year.

Chapter 2 Motor Vehicle Registration > Section 5 Cancellation of Registration > Article 38

Article 38 Where the circumstances specified in Item 1 or Item 2 of the first paragraph of Article 37 apply, and the motor vehicle owner applies for cancellation of registration, the motor vehicle shall be sold to a scrap motor vehicle recycling enterprise, the application information shall be confirmed, and the motor vehicle registration certificate, license plate, and driving license shall be submitted.

The scrap motor vehicle recycling enterprise shall confirm the motor vehicle, issue a scrap motor vehicle recycling certificate to the motor vehicle owner, and submit the application form, motor vehicle registration certificate, license plate, driving license, and a copy of the scrap motor vehicle recycling certificate to the vehicle management office within seven days. Where it is a scrapped school bus, large passenger bus, heavy truck, or other operating vehicle, when applying for cancellation of registration, the vehicle identification number rubbing film, photos or electronic data of vehicle dismantling shall also be submitted.

The vehicle management office shall, within one day from the date of acceptance, review the submitted certificates and vouchers, recover the motor vehicle registration certificate, license plate, and driving license, and issue a cancellation certificate.

Where the vehicle is not at the place of registration, the motor vehicle owner may sell the scrap motor vehicle to a motor vehicle recycling enterprise at the place where the vehicle is located. The scrap motor vehicle recycling enterprise shall confirm the motor vehicle, issue a scrap motor vehicle recycling certificate to the motor vehicle owner, and submit the application form, motor vehicle registration certificate, license plate, driving license, copy of the scrap motor vehicle recycling certificate, and vehicle identification number rubbing film or electronic data to the vehicle management office at the place of scrapping within seven days. Where it is a scrapped school bus, large passenger bus, heavy truck, or other operating vehicle, photos or electronic data of vehicle dismantling shall also be submitted.

The vehicle management office at the place of scrapping shall, within one day from the date of acceptance, review the submitted certificates and vouchers, recover the motor vehicle registration certificate, license plate, and driving license, and transmit the motor vehicle scrapping information to the vehicle management office at the place of registration through the computer registration management system. The vehicle management office at the place of registration shall complete the cancellation registration within one day from the date of receiving the motor vehicle scrapping information, and issue a cancellation certificate.

The "Decision of the Ministry of Public Security on Amending the 'Provisions on the Procedures for Handling Road Traffic Safety Illegal Acts'" was adopted at the Ministry of Public Security Party Committee Meeting on February 12, 2020, and is hereby promulgated, coming into force on May 1, 2020.

Decision of the Ministry of Public Security on Amending the "Provisions on the Procedures for Handling Road Traffic Safety Illegal Acts"
To further standardize and improve the procedures for handling road traffic safety illegal acts, the Ministry of Public Security decides to make the following amendments to certain provisions of the "Provisions on the Procedures for Handling Road Traffic Safety Illegal Acts":
1. Article 5 is amended to read: "The perpetrator of an illegal act may handle traffic violations recorded by traffic technical monitoring equipment at the public security organ traffic management department where the illegal act occurred, where the motor vehicle is registered, or at any other location.

"If the perpetrator of an illegal act or the owner or manager of a motor vehicle objects to the facts of a traffic violation recorded by traffic technical monitoring equipment, they may submit a request to the public security organ traffic management department through the internet website of the public security organ traffic management department, a mobile internet application, or a violation handling window. The public security organ traffic management department at the handling location shall, on the same day it receives the application from the party concerned, notify the public security organ traffic management department where the illegal act occurred through the Road Traffic Violation Information Management System. The public security organ traffic management department where the illegal act occurred shall review the matter within five days; if the objection is valid, it shall be eliminated;

text:
Article 28: Traffic police shall, within twenty-four hours after detaining a vehicle, transfer the detained vehicle to the public security organ traffic management department to which they belong.
Where the public security organ traffic management department detains a vehicle, it shall not detain the cargo loaded on the vehicle. The party concerned shall be notified to handle the cargo loaded on the vehicle by themselves; if the party concerned is unable to handle it by themselves or fails to handle it by themselves, it shall be registered and properly kept. For items that are prone to rot, damage, loss, or other conditions not suitable for storage, upon approval by the person in charge of the public security organ traffic management department at or above the county level, they may be sold or auctioned after photographing or video recording. The proceeds from the sale or auction shall be handled in accordance with relevant regulations.

Chapter 4 Application of Administrative Compulsory Measures > Article 29

Article 29: Where a highway passenger transport vehicle carries passengers exceeding the approved number of passengers, or a freight motor vehicle exceeds the approved load mass, the public security organ traffic management department shall eliminate the illegal state in accordance with the following provisions:
(1) If the violator can eliminate the illegal state by themselves, they shall, under the supervision of the public security organ traffic management department, transfer the excess passengers by themselves and unload the excess cargo;
(2) If the violator cannot eliminate the illegal state by themselves, for excess passengers, the public security organ traffic management department shall promptly notify relevant departments to contact and arrange transfer; for excess cargo, it shall be unloaded at a designated site, and the violator shall sign a custody contract for the unloaded cargo with the custodian of the designated site.
The costs of eliminating the illegal state shall be borne by the violator. After the illegal state is eliminated, the detained motor vehicle shall be returned immediately.

Article 59 For fines imposed on pedestrians, passengers, or non-motor vehicle drivers, if the traffic police collect the fine on the spot, the traffic police shall note it on the simplified procedure penalty decision letter, and the person punished shall sign to confirm. Article 74 Where motor vehicle registration is obtained by deception, bribery, or other improper means, the motor vehicle registration certificate, license plate, and vehicle license shall be confiscated, and the motor vehicle registration shall be revoked by the public security organ traffic management department at the place of motor vehicle registration.
